hacker_news.title: Show HN: Puppet Master – Manage coding agents at scale
hacker_news.author: chrismoos
hacker_news.summary: A control plane for coding agents. Run many Claude Code, Codex or Gemini sessions across unrelated projects, watch all of them on one page, and get told the moment one is waiting on you.

linked_context.page_description: A control plane for coding agents. Run many Claude Code, Codex or Gemini sessions across unrelated projects, watch all of them on one page, and get told the moment one is waiting on you.
linked_context.page_excerpt:
Puppet Master spawns and supervises real Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and more sessions across every project you have open. It shows what each one is doing, and tells you the moment one is waiting on you.

Every session in the dashboard is a live PTY rendered with xterm.js — the same terminal the agent is driving. You can type into it, resize it and scroll back through it, and have it open in the browser, on the iOS app, in pm attach and in the TUI at the same time.

Puppet Master starts the agent CLI you already use and watches it, rather than reimplementing it on top of an API. Nothing about how you work with an agent changes — the prompts, the permission requests and the output are the ones you would get in your own terminal.

hacker_news.content_context:
As I started to use `claude` and `codex` more it became too hard to manage all the sessions across all my tmux panes and sessions, so I built Puppet Master.

I see now there is quite a lot out there now for managing agents to write software, but

a) I started working on this before a lot of them, and b) there are things in Puppet Master that just don't exist all in one product.

For me I'd say the highlights are:

1) Web instead of terminal -- it's just a richer interface

2) iOS app so I can keep working on things from anywhere

3) Local + Remote workers (heterogeneous fleet), I work on things that are cross-platform and PM lets agents spawn across the fleet depending on workload needs.

4) Connections - first-class support for integrating MCP and REST API (ala OpenAPI definitions) into your agents. This goes above and beyond what a single harness can do via i.e an MCP integration. PM imports it (scoped to a bucket/project) and associates it to a policy. It lives between the agent and the remote MCP/API and enforces a policy. hacker_news.title: Jev-as-a-Judge for Agent Evaluations
hacker_news.author: omarsar
hacker_news.summary: See how Jev checks an agent's request, tool calls, results, and final answer.

linked_context.page_title: Jev-as-a-Judge for Agent Evaluations | DAIR.AI Academy
linked_context.page_description: See how Jev checks an agent's request, tool calls, results, and final answer.
linked_context.page_excerpt:
LLM-as-a-judge means using a large language model (LLM) to evaluate the work of another model. You give the judge an output, or a pair of outputs, along with the criteria that matter, and it scores, ranks, or compares them. Did the answer follow the policy? Is response A better than response B? Did the agent actually finish the task?

This approach is useful because manual review does not scale. A person can carefully read a few dozen outputs, but a judge model can apply the same criteria to thousands of runs, every time you change a prompt, a tool, or a model.

Jev is a new model built specifically for this kind of decision, which makes it a natural fit for the judge role. Using Jev as the judging LLM is what this tutorial means by Jev-as-a-Judge .

top_trends.author: chrismoos
top_trends.summary: A control plane for coding agents. Run many Claude Code, Codex or Gemini sessions across unrelated projects, watch all of them on one page, and get told the moment one is waiting on you.

linked_context.page_description: A control plane for coding agents. Run many Claude Code, Codex or Gemini sessions across unrelated projects, watch all of them on one page, and get told the moment one is waiting on you.
linked_context.page_excerpt:
Puppet Master spawns and supervises real Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and more sessions across every project you have open. It shows what each one is doing, and tells you the moment one is waiting on you.

Every session in the dashboard is a live PTY rendered with xterm.js — the same terminal the agent is driving. You can type into it, resize it and scroll back through it, and have it open in the browser, on the iOS app, in pm attach and in the TUI at the same time.

Puppet Master starts the agent CLI you already use and watches it, rather than reimplementing it on top of an API. Nothing about how you work with an agent changes — the prompts, the permission requests and the output are the ones you would get in your own terminal.

top_trends.content_context:
As I started to use `claude` and `codex` more it became too hard to manage all the sessions across all my tmux panes and sessions, so I built Puppet Master.

I see now there is quite a lot out there now for managing agents to write software, but

a) I started working on this before a lot of them, and b) there are things in Puppet Master that just don't exist all in one product.

For me I'd say the highlights are:

1) Web instead of terminal -- it's just a richer interface

2) iOS app so I can keep working on things from anywhere

3) Local + Remote workers (heterogeneous fleet), I work on things that are cross-platform and PM lets agents spawn across the fleet depending on workload needs.

4) Connections - first-class support for integrating MCP and REST API (ala OpenAPI definitions) into your agents. This goes above and beyond what a single harness can do via i.e an MCP integration. PM imports it (scoped to a bucket/project) and associates it to a policy. It lives between the agent and the remote MCP/API and enforces a policy. source_briefs.item_name: Show HN: Puppet Master – Manage coding agents at scale
source_briefs.content_summary: Puppet Master 是一个用于规模化管理编程AI代理（如Claude Code、Codex、Gemini）的控制平面。它解决了在多项目、多tmux会话中管理代理会话的难题。其核心特点包括：基于Web的丰富界面、iOS移动端应用、支持本地和远程异构工作节点、以及对MCP和REST API（如OpenAPI）集成的原生支持，并包含权限审批流程。它通过监控现有的代理CLI来工作，而非重新实现API。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 该产品瞄准了AI编程代理工作流管理中的痛点，特别是多任务并行和跨平台协作。其‘监督而非重构’的理念降低了用户迁移成本，而集成的审批机制则增强了在自动化写入操作时的安全可控性。

source_briefs.content_summary: iter0.com 是一个面向科技创业者的AI网站构建器。用户可以从简介或参考网站开始，生成设计后可在画布上审查和细化。产品强调能清晰展示复杂的AI智能体工作流，并支持通过故事、适配和材料来销售产品的电子商务功能。Hacker News上的相关评论已被标记。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 该项目试图在拥挤的网站建设市场中，通过聚焦‘科技创业者’和‘AI智能体工作流可视化’等细分需求来寻找差异化。将AI网站生成与电商叙事结合，是内容营销工具化的一个体现。

source_briefs.item_name: Show HN: ZWhispr – Three speech models are better than one
source_briefs.content_summary: ZWhispr 是一个语音转录服务，其核心创新在于融合多个顶尖语音模型的输出，结合用户词典和屏幕上下文信息，在模型结果出现分歧时选择最优转录，从而获得比任何单一模型更低的错误率。该系统设计确保延迟不会受最慢模型拖累。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 该方法采用了模型融合（Ensemble）策略来提升语音识别的鲁棒性和准确性，同时利用屏幕上下文进行消歧，是提升实用场景下转录精度的有效思路。关注延迟优化也体现了对用户体验的重视。

source_briefs.item_name: Crypto megadonors play it safe in the House - Politico
source_briefs.content_summary: 加密货币行业的大额政治捐款者在众议院选举中采取稳妥策略。主要加密货币组织Fairshake PAC网络计划在关键立法停滞后，向两党的一系列众议院竞选投入数百万美元，目前已支持32名两党现任议员。相关报道指出，这些PAC支持的竞选目标引发了关注。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这表明加密货币行业正在通过广泛支持两党议员的方式来扩大政治影响力，为未来的立法铺路，是一种规避单一政党风险的长线投资策略。

source_briefs.item_name: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say - BBC
source_briefs.content_summary: 美国田纳西州死囚克里斯塔·派克在处决失败后恢复意识并能说话。其律师称，她在田纳西州失败的处决尝试后幸存下来。使用的药物戊巴比妥曾受到审查。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 此次失败的处决事件可能再次引发对美国死刑执行方式，特别是药物注射程序及其合规性、人道性的全国性辩论。

source_briefs.item_name: Trump Does Not Plan to Reimburse Taxpayers for Promotional Ads - The New York Times
source_briefs.content_summary: 特朗普表示，在因使用纳税人资金进行宣传广告引发反弹后，他将自己支付竞选式广告费用，但不会偿还联邦政府已经支出的由纳税人资助的广告费用。相关报道指出，他对于偿还已播出广告的政府资金态度模糊。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 此事凸显了公职人物使用公共资源进行个人或政治宣传的伦理边界问题，特朗普的回应可能无法完全平息关于滥用纳税人资金的批评。
